key_id_rule: A key_id is sha256: and the SHA-256 of the key's SubjectPublicKeyInfo, DER-encoded, in lower-case hexadecimal.
verification: A release is Lex's when the signature in its release-manifest.sig.json verifies over the bytes of its release-manifest.json under a key of this set, the manifest names that key's identity as its signer, and the key was active on the release's date. Its lex-v3-image.sig.json verifies under the same key over a payload that names the image's manifest digest. Verify against this set, never only against the key a release carries inside itself.
verifier: node web/scripts/deploy-probe.mjs --release <release directory> --public-key <the key, as a PEM file> --signer lex-v3-release, from the public repository
rotation: Each key is replaced within a year of its valid_from date, and at once on any suspicion of compromise. A replaced or compromised key stays listed, with its status and the date it stopped being used.

signs: the bytes of release-manifest.json, in release-manifest.sig.json
a payload naming the release image's manifest digest, in lex-v3-image.sig.json
keys.custody: The private key is held in Azure Key Vault.
keys.note: Releases signed before 2026-10-26 name this same key's signer under an earlier label.
